subject: Re: Contoso - Marketplace listing vs Partner Center referral routing
messages:
From: Danielle McCoy <danielle.mccoy@contoso.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Marketplace listing seems to be routing to wrong seller

Hi Soojin,

Quick note — our field team noticed that several Partner Center referrals generated from the Azure Marketplace listing are being routed to an internal seller who doesn't own the accounts in our CRM. That mismatch is causing delays in demos and pricing. Can Redwood confirm how Partner Center is matching marketplace leads to seller IDs?

We ran a quick export and attached the CSV from our side; you'll see a few high-value accounts (Contoso Retail, Contoso Supply) landed with a seller we don't recognize. Can we get a short call this week to reconcile mapping and to make sure marketplace listing metadata (offer ID/Publisher tenant) is aligned with the PC referral mapping?

Thanks,
Danielle McCoy
Head of Cloud Marketplace Programs | Contoso
Attachment: contoso-pc-referral-issues-20270524.csv (csv)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Danielle McCoy <danielle.mccoy@contoso.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing seems to be routing to wrong seller

Thanks for flagging this, Danielle — and sorry for the disruption. We're on it.

Short response and proposed next steps below:

- Hypothesis: Partner Center referral routing is matching on Publisher tenant + offering metadata, but seller mapping in PC can also be influenced by seller consent/claim state and "owner" field in our account ledger. If a Marketplace offer was created under a different publisher tenant or the account was claimed post-referral, routing can flip.
- Immediate ask: Danielle, can you share the Marketplace offer ID(s) and the HubSpot contact IDs for the affected accounts? That will let us correlate with our referral logs.
- Internal ask (Vanessa / Karthik): can you pull a Partner Center snapshot for the offer IDs and the PC referral audit for 05/01-05/24? Ben — please surface any recent seller consent changes for the APAC/US field sellers that might influence routing.

I attached a blank mapping template and will schedule a 30-min sync for tomorrow to go through the rows. If we confirm data-level mismatch, plan is: (1) update PC owner mapping, (2) ensure Marketplace metadata tags offer->owner correctly, (3) push a short "how we route referrals" note to Contoso field.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Partner Programs | Redwood Inference
Attachment: pc-referral-mapping-template.csv (csv)

Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing seems to be routing to wrong seller — PC snapshot attached

Adding the data side — I pulled the Partner Center referral snapshot for 05/01-05/24 and exported the PC owner ledger. Two findings:

1) Offer ID mismatch: Three Marketplace offers for Contoso were published under a legacy publisher tenant (publisher-legacy-298) and the newer publisher tenant (publisher-main-112). PC routing prefers the publisher tenant on the referral payload; if the offerId in the marketplace payload doesn't match the PC record, referrals can land in the fallback seller pool.
2) Seller consent toggles: For two of the affected seller IDs we see a recent consent revocation (05/18) in our ledger which will route referrals to a local "unassigned" or default seller until consent is re-granted.

I attached the CSV snapshot (contoso-pc-referral-snapshot-20270524.csv) and a short markdown note with the diff logic (marketplace-listing-diff-notes-20270525.md). Recommendation: re-associate the legacy offers to publisher-main-112 (simple metadata update at the marketplace listing level) and have the field re-grant consent for the two seller IDs.

Questions for the group:
- Vanessa: do we have an authoritative owner map per account (SalesForce/HubSpot canonical ID) we should use for PC?
- Ben: if we update publisher on listing side, can we push a re-emit of referral events or will we need manual reconciliation with Contoso?

Karthik
Senior Partner Ops | Redwood Inference
Attachment: contoso-pc-referral-snapshot-20270524.csv (csv)
Attachment: marketplace-listing-diff-notes-20270525.md (md)

Subject: Re: Marketplace listing seems to be routing to wrong seller — owner map and next steps

Thanks — quick operational notes from field coverage perspective:

- Authoritative owner map: SalesForce is the canonical source for owner-to-account. Laura, can you export owner_id + hubspot_id for the Contoso GRP accounts listed and drop to the shared Drive link? That will let us drive deterministic owner assignment in PC.
- Consent flow: Ben — we need a short field playbook to ask sellers to re-grant marketplace consent and to confirm ownership. If the seller has moved territories, we should mark account as "unassigned" in PC and route to the local regional seller pool rather than defaulting to a single owner.
- Marketplace publishing: if the legacy publisher tenant is still associated with older offerIds we should update those offers and request a referral re-emit. Danielle — once we flip the publisher we can test with 2 pilot referrals to validate routing before doing a bulk re-emit.

I'll join the sync tomorrow; bringing Laura and Ben to close the loop on data + field steps.

Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Partner Field Programs | Redwood Inference

Date: Sat, 29 May 2027 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Action plan: Contoso marketplace listing / PC referral reconciliation (summary + owners)

Folks — thanks for the quick turnaround this week. Below is a concise mutual action plan and owners. Danielle, I've included the minimal steps for your platform team so we can validate end-to-end.

Summary of root causes:
- Some Contoso offers existed under a legacy publisher tenant which caused referral payloads to reference the wrong publisher->fallback routing.
- Two seller IDs lost consent around 2027-05-18 which routed referrals into the default/unassigned pool.

Mutual action plan (owners + due dates):
1) Marketplace offer metadata update — update legacy offers to publisher-main-112 and tag offer -> owner (Contoso) [Owner: Danielle / Contoso Platform] — Due: 2027-05-31
2) PC owner reconciliation — Redwood to import SalesForce canonical owner map and push authoritative owner->seller mapping into Partner Center [Owner: Laura Bennett / Redwood] — Due: 2027-06-02
3) Consent re-grant & field confirmation — sellers to re-grant marketplace consent or mark accounts unassigned if territory changed [Owner: Ben Carter / Redwood Field Ops] — Due: 2027-05-28
4) Pilot referrals & validation — perform 2 test referrals after metadata flip to confirm routing, capture logs and confirm with Contoso repack [Owner: Karthik Iyer / Redwood] — Due: 2027-06-03
5) Bulk re-emit (if pilot passes) or manual reconciliation for the 12 affected referrals from 05/01-05/24 [Owner: Soojin Lee / Redwood + Danielle McCoy / Contoso] — Target: 2027-06-07

Attachments: mutual-action-plan-contoso-20270529.pdf (pdf) — I uploaded the same to the shared Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB_example_shared_drive
HubSpot reference: HS-Deal-98473; I added a note to the contact.

If everyone is aligned, I'll mark tasks in Asana and send calendar invites for the pilot test window next week.

Thanks all — short sync recorded notes will follow.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Partner Programs | Redwood Inference
Attachment: mutual-action-plan-contoso-20270529.pdf (pdf)
